name: fullenrich
description: FullEnrich MCP search, enrichment, and CSV/JSON export for AI agents. Find prospects, enrich verified emails and phone numbers via waterfall enrichment (25+ data providers), and export results. Includes 9 guided skills for prospecting, CSV enrichment, outreach, sequences, meeting prep, talent sourcing, lookalikes, org charts, and optional orchestration of a separately connected CRM MCP. Contact data comes from third-party B2B data providers and is processed on the basis of legitimate interest; a listed person can opt out at https://fullenrich.com/optout or support@fullenrich.com.
